reference_quality.method: multi-step finite-difference convergence study with row-level classification
reference_quality.policy: A row counts only when a plateau across at least three consecutive step sizes resolves the reference and the OTI value lies inside it, or when the derivative is zero with support independent of the OTI result. No row is passed for falling below a large absolute tolerance.
reference_quality.supersedes: The earlier single-step comparison passed rows against absolute tolerances as large as 4.0e4 at order 4. Those tolerances no longer carry any row: every controlled J2 and code_imp row is now carried by a resolved plateau or by independent zero support.
